title: Salty Dog Charters, LLC

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Salty Dog Charters, being myself and some of my close friends have begun handing out poboys in New Orleans at least one day a month. This began a couple years back when I was giving out whole fish to people who needed a meal. Then I started thinking about it... and for some having the food cooked helped them out even more, as they did not have homes to cook in. So we have started fileting, frying, and handing out meals to those who need it. No real reason other then for once to give something to someone without asking anything in return. I believe its something we need in this world to balance out everything else we encounter in our somewhat competative lives. Anyways It feels great, and

blurb: Salty Dog Charters has some of the best speckled trout and redfish action in all of Louisiana! It is just a bonus that we are located close enough for day trips out of The French Quarter and New Orleans! We fish the marsh, bays, and islands located in the north east section of the Mississippi delta. We are harbored in Shell Beach Louisiana which gives us front door access to Lake Borgne, Biloxi Marsh, Breton Sound,
